title: BINAH Task Decomposition Request
description: Request contract for the second-level decomposition of a validated business need into process, activity, and task characteristics.

business_map.description: Business operational map providing structural context for the decomposition.

reality_gate.description: Reality Gate result authorizing the second-level decomposition.

area.description: Business area affected by the need.

function.description: Business function affected by the need.

actor.description: Actor responsible for performing the task.

frequency.description: Frequency with which the task is performed.

time.description: Time required to perform the task.

volume.description: Volume of work handled by the task.

input.description: Inputs required to perform the task.

information.description: Information required to perform or support the task.

decision.description: Decision involved in or produced by the task.

errors.description: Errors or error patterns associated with the task.

human_role.description: Human role currently involved in the task.

bottleneck.description: Bottleneck or constraint associated with the task.

efficiency.description: Current efficiency characteristics of the task.
